query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `purchaseRequests` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `requestCode` varchar(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `customerId` int NOT NULL,
  `customerName` varchar(255),
  `customerCode` varchar(100),
  `productUrl` varchar(1000),
  `productName` varchar(500),
  `productDescription` text,
  `productImages` json,
  `color` varchar(100),
  `size` varchar(100),
  `quantity` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `customerNotes` text,
  `deliveryAddress` text,
  `deliveryCity` varchar(100),
  `deliveryPhone` varchar(20),
  `status` enum('pending','quoted','accepted','rejected','cancelled','payment_pending','paid','purchasing','purchased','in_transit','arrived','delivered','completed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `productPrice` decimal(10,2),
  `productPriceCurrency` varchar(10) DEFAULT 'USD',
  `shippingCost` decimal(10,2),
  `serviceFee` decimal(10,2),
  `localDeliveryCost` decimal(10,2),
  `totalPrice` decimal(10,2),
  `adminNotes` text,
  `quotedById` int,
  `quotedByName` varchar(255),
  `quotedAt` timestamp,
  `customerResponse` enum('pending','accepted','rejected','negotiating') DEFAULT 'pending',
  `customerResponseAt` timestamp,
  `customerResponseNotes` text,
  `paidFromWallet` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `paymentTransactionId` int,
  `paidAt` timestamp,
  `purchaseOrderNumber` varchar(100),
  `purchaseReceipt` varchar(500),
  `purchasedAt` timestamp,
  `purchasedById` int,
  `trackingNumber` varchar(100),
  `trackingCarrier` varchar(100),
  `estimatedDelivery` timestamp,
  `linkedPackageId` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
);
